units.source_text: 他家中连日大办修法祈祷，然而那鬼魂越来越凶，大肆骚扰。

en.t: In his household, elaborate rites and prayers were held day after day, yet the spirit only grew more violent and caused great disturbance.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将闻之，设想此刻如果归家，势必闹出丑闻，被人耻笑，害怕之极，越发不敢回去。

en.t: When General Higekuro heard of this, he imagined that if he returned home now it would surely cause a scandal and make him a laughingstock; terrified, he dared even less to go back.

units.source_text: 后来虽然回去，也离居在别室中，只把子女叫进来抚爱一番。

en.t: Although he later returned, he lived apart in another room and merely called in his children to show them some affection.

units.source_text: 他有一个女儿，年方十二三岁。

en.t: He had one daughter, just twelve or thirteen years old.
Below her there were also two younger boys.

units.source_text: 近几年来，他对夫人虽然逐渐疏远，但总把她当作一位高贵无比的正夫人看待。

en.t: In recent years, although he had gradually grown distant from his wife, he had always treated her as an incomparably noble principal wife.

units.source_text: 如今看看情缘即将断绝，众侍女都觉得十分悲伤。

en.t: Now, seeing that their bond was about to be severed, all the ladies-in-waiting felt deeply saddened.
